messages:
Arjun Patel (AE): quick handoff for EastLake Corp — closing today, moving to onboarding. summary below.

Arjun Patel (AE): account: EastLake (FinTech, enterprise). ARR: $480k annual. Commitment: Dedicated + Private (VPC) + 12-month reserved capacity.

Arjun Patel (AE): current status: PO signed, legal done, provision requested. Security questionnaire flagged need for HSM + audit logs. SSO (SAML) still pending from their side.

Maya Chen (CSM): @Lena @Tom taking this. I'll own onboarding plan and renewal health. high-level risk: MED-HIGH while SSO not validated — finance pushing timeline.

Lena Ortiz (Support Eng): noted. technical owners? who will run initial private deploy validation?

Tom Vargas (Eng Escalations): I can take the private deploy smoke tests and HSM integration checklist. need access to customer's KMS config and certs.

Arjun Patel (AE): contacts: primary buyer = Sarah Ng (Dir IT), technical lead = Mark Ruiz (SRE). Sarah is focused on compliance; Mark will coordinate cert/KMS exchange. I'll intro on email after this thread.

Maya Chen (CSM): onboarding milestones I propose:
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff + enablement (product tour + integration owners).
- Week 1: SSO test environment + SAML assertion exchange.
- Week 2: Private deploy in staging (Eng smoke tests).
- Week 3: Performance validation and SLAs.
- Week 4: Prod cutover + post-launch checklist.

Maya Chen (CSM): initial enablement session scheduled Thu 9am PT (30m). invite sent to Sarah and Mark. agenda: account overview, basic API usage, SDKs, and private deployment overview.

Lena Ortiz (Support Eng): action items for support:
- Collect SAML metadata from EastLake (Mark).
- Validate SAML flow in dev environment and share logs.
- Create runbook entry: eastlake-saml.md (internal).

Tom Vargas (Eng Escalations): action items for eng:
- Request KMS/HSM access details via secure form (Maya to coordinate).
- Run private-deploy smoke:
```
# smoke test commands
redwoodctl deploy --env staging --account eastlake --model r-instruct-3b
redwoodctl health-check --account eastlake --timeout 60s
```
- Capture kernel/quantization profile used.

Maya Chen (CSM): risk & mitigation notes:
- Risk: Renewal pressure if integration drags >6 weeks. (Score: 6/10)
- Mitigation: prioritize SSO and HSM path, offer short-term hosted fallback (hosted API) to unblock product teams while private work completes.

Arjun Patel (AE): finance has asked for a migration timeline by next Tue. can we commit to the Week 2 staging smoke tests?

Tom Vargas (Eng Escalations): yes we can commit to smoke tests by Tue EOD if we receive KMS details by Mon midday. otherwise will slip.

Maya Chen (CSM): I'll chase Mark for SAML metadata + KMS contact this morning. will post updates here.

Lena Ortiz (Support Eng): logging/observability ask from customer: token-level cost breakdown and per-route latency charts. I'll prepare dashboard template (shared link) and attach.

Maya Chen (CSM): feedback capture: we'll run two short surveys post-kickoff (integration clarity + docs usefulness). link: https://redwood.internal/surveys/eastlake (placeholder)

Arjun Patel (AE): handoff note for billing: billing contact = Priya Desai. start-of-service date = TBD after prod cutover.

Maya Chen (CSM): next steps owners + deadlines:
- Maya: secure KMS contact + email intro (today EOD).
- Mark (customer): provide SAML metadata + certs (Mon).
- Lena: validate SAML in dev and create runbook (Tue).
- Tom: run private staging smoke + share results (Tue EOD).
- Arjun: follow up on billing + confirm PO details (today).

oncall-bot: Note: private-deploy pipeline has a queued job for eastlake (id: 8102). triggered when eng marks ready.

Maya Chen (CSM): tagging this as OWNER=Maya. I'll update thread when I have the customer's SAML metadata and KMS contact. please add any missing blockers. :thumbsup:

Arjun Patel (AE): thanks all — appreciate the quick sync. I'll send the intro email now and cc this thread.

Lena Ortiz (Support Eng): thanks — will start the runbook draft after intro email.

Tom Vargas (Eng Escalations): will reserve time Tue to run the smoke tests.

Maya Chen (CSM): closing loop: intro email sent 2028-06-12 14:05 PT. keeping this thread for updates.
